source.title: The Land Buying Mistake That Can Cost Crores!
source.description:
If you're buying land near a river, stream or water body, there are important flood-line and development restrictions you need to understand before making a purchase.

A few metres can make a massive difference to what you can and cannot do with your land.

Before you buy land, don't just look at the view. Check the restrictions.

source_evidence_points: Water bodies have mandatory statutory setback/buffer zones where all construction is legally prohibited.
Relying only on physical site appearance without checking official flood lines and channel maps leads to buying unbuildable land.
Official PWD/Master Plan maps demarcate restricted buffer lines that override private property boundaries.
pack.topic: Waterbody Setback & Buffer Zone Due Diligence in Coimbatore Property Buying
pack.source_script_insight: Scenic waterfront property can become legally useless for construction if statutory buffer zones and flood line restrictions are ignored during pre-purchase due diligence.
pack.coimbatore_angle: In Coimbatore, land situated near Noyyal river channels, PWD irrigation tanks, or local natural drainage streams (kulams and canal pathways) is subject to strict state setback laws and DTCP master plan restrictions. Buyers must inspect government survey sketches rather than just ground conditions.
pack.visual_strategy: The visuals focus strictly on legal verification physical evidence: official survey maps, measuring tapes near natural drainage channels, PWD setback drawings, and DTCP master plan documents. This avoids standard decorative house or plot clips, grounding the video entirely in statutory compliance evidence.
pack.core_takeaway: Always verify official PWD channel maps and DTCP master plan setback lines before purchasing property near any Coimbatore water body.

pack.gemini_video_prompt:
A. MANDATORY OUTPUT FORMAT LOCK
- Exact duration: 10.0 seconds total.
- Aspect ratio: Native portrait 9:16 vertical video frame filling 100% of the canvas.
- Frame rate: 30 fps, continuous photorealistic camera motion.
- Target Audience & Location: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu ONLY for OliveTree Investors.

B. REALISM LOCK
- Absolute photorealism requirement. Captured on 35mm cinema lens, realistic dynamic range, soft natural sunlight exposure, authentic South Indian environmental textures.
- Zero CGI, zero 3D architectural renders, zero cartoon graphics, zero animated explainers.
- Natural soil, authentic red clay soil textures, real Coimbatore coconut palm backdrops, authentic Tamil Nadu government layout maps and survey blueprints.

C. SOURCE SUBJECT LOCK
- Primary Subject: Legal Risk & Statutory Setback Rules (Waterbody Buffer Zones).
- Core Evidence Points: Statutory buffer zones prohibit building near water bodies; physical visual verification of land is insufficient; government PWD and DTCP alignment maps dictate buildable area.
- Application: Specific to property buyers in Coimbatore evaluating plots near Noyyal channels, roadside culverts, and PWD irrigation tanks.

D. SUBJECT-SPECIFIC VISUAL STRATEGY
- Focus exclusively on the physical evidence of legal compliance: paper survey blueprints, field measuring tools, statutory marking stones, and actual stream bank boundaries.
- FORBIDDEN DEFAULT STORY: Do NOT show generic empty plots, CGI house assembly, completed villas, moving families, construction workers, or generic happy investors.

E. CAMERA + IMAGE QUALITY
- Handheld physical feel with subtle optical stabilization.
- Crisp optical focus on document ink, paper textures, survey marks, and natural landscape lighting.
- Color Palette: Earthy greens, warm Tamil Nadu sunshine, true paper off-whites, crisp crimson red line accents on technical drawings.

F. EXACT 7-SHOT PLAN

- Shot 1 (0.0s - 1.4s):
  - Location: Real property field setting near suburban Coimbatore.
  - Subject: An official government land survey map unrolling over a wooden clipboard on a site table.
  - Framing: High-angle macro tilt down.
  - Details: Crisp line art on blueprint paper depicting a water channel alongside plot numbers.
  - Text Overlay: 'Waterfront Land?' (minimal white sans-serif, top center).
  - Tamil VO: 'நீர்நிலை அருகே நிலம் வாங்குகிறீர்களா?'

- Shot 2 (1.4s - 2.8s):
  - Location: Office desk environment with natural window side-lighting.
  - Subject: Close-up of a hand using a red marker to trace a 15-meter statutory setback line on a local PWD drainage layout blueprint.
  - Framing: Macro extreme close-up on paper texture.
  - Text Overlay: 'Buffer Zone Rule'
  - Tamil VO: 'சட்டப்பூர்வ ஃபஃபர் மண்டல விதிகளை'

- Shot 3 (2.8s - 4.2s):
  - Location: Agricultural fringe near Coimbatore bypass road.
  - Subject: Ground-level tracking shot along a extended yellow professional survey tape stretching from a small stream bank into lush green land.
  - Framing: Low-angle linear tracking shot.
  - Text Overlay: 'No Construction Zone'
  - Tamil VO: 'கவனிக்காவிட்டால்,'

- Shot 4 (4.2s - 5.6s):
  - Location: Legal review table environment.
  - Subject: Top-down view of a local municipal master plan document with a clear red setback restriction boundary overlay.
  - Framing: Direct overhead static shot.
  - Text Overlay: 'Permit Denied'
  - Tamil VO: 'அங்கு கட்டடம் கட்ட முடியாது!'

- Shot 5 (5.6s - 7.0s):
  - Location: Suburban Coimbatore open land with distant Coconut trees.
  - Subject: Real estate buyer standing near a roadside PWD channel wall, comparing physical ground boundaries with a folded layout plan.
  - Framing: Eye-level medium shot.
  - Text Overlay: 'Check Official Maps'
  - Tamil VO: 'வெறும் இடத்தை மட்டும் பார்க்காமல்,'

- Shot 6 (7.0s - 8.5s):
  - Location: Document inspection setting.
  - Subject: Precision scale ruler measuring valid building setback distances on a certified DTCP layout plan.
  - Framing: Close-up focus pull from ruler edge to official approval seal.
  - Text Overlay: 'Verify Setbacks'
  - Tamil VO: 'அரசு வரைபடங்களைச் சரிபார்க்கவும்.'

- Shot 7 (8.5s - 10.0s):
  - Location: Verified DTCP approved layout plot in Coimbatore.
  - Subject: Clean yellow survey stone firmly planted in soil with clear site boundaries in background bathed in golden afternoon light.
  - Framing: Ground-level steady shot.
  - Text Overlay: 'OliveTree Investors' (bottom center, elegant clean typography).
  - Tamil VO: 'பாதுகாப்பான முதலீட்டிற்கு ஆலிவ்ட்ரீ இன்வெஸ்டர்ஸ்!'

G. MOTION-GRAPHICS LIMIT
- Only subtle text overlays (1-3 words) directly rendered over real footage. No full-screen motion graphics or animated vector charts.

H. FINAL REAL SCENE
- Concludes directly on Scene 7 real-world plot mark under warm sun with subtle OliveTree Investors text overlay. No synthetic end card.

I. NEGATIVE PROMPT / FIXED RULES
- Strict prohibition: 2D/3D animation, explainers, architectural render visualizers, plastic surfaces, fake city skylines, floating text boxes, camera whip-pans, generic stock family scenes,Chennai/Bengaluru references, exaggerated financial charts, camera crew reflections.
pack.title_english: The Land Buying Mistake Near Water Bodies in Coimbatore
pack.caption_english: Buying land near a stream or PWD water channel in Coimbatore looks scenic, but statutory buffer zones can make the plot legally unbuildable. Master plan regulations and local drainage setback rules prohibit structural construction within designated buffer corridors. Never rely solely on visual site inspections or verbal promises. Always verify official PWD channel alignment drawings and DTCP layout approvals before making an advance payment. Ensure your land investment is 100% buildable and legally secure with OliveTree Investors.
